D: Two neighbours go to war over a house full of Christmas lights bright enough to be seen from space.
P: Serve the snacks when the lights go on.
S: Cherry tomato and baby bocconcini skewers with basil oil

Red cherry tomatoes, white bocconcini and green basil threaded on skewers like a string of Christmas lights, with balsamic glaze and basil oil. Blitz a handful of basil leaves with 60ml olive oil and a pinch of salt, then strain. Halve 24 baby bocconcini. Thread 24 skewers with a cherry tomato, a basil leaf and a bocconcini half, then another tomato, from 250g cherry tomatoes. Lay them in rows on a long platter like strings of lights. Drizzle with the basil oil and balsamic glaze and finish with cracked pepper and sea salt.
Baked beef and pork meatballs glazed in cranberry sweet chilli sauce

Little pork and beef meatballs baked golden and tossed in a sticky cranberry, chilli and soy glaze, served on toothpicks. Mix 300g beef mince, 200g pork mince, 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 1 crushed garlic clove and salt. Roll into 24 balls and bake on a lined tray at 200C for 15 minutes. Simmer 200g cranberry sauce, 3 tbsp sweet chilli sauce, 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp lemon juice for 3 minutes until glossy. Toss the meatballs through, scatter with sliced spring onion and serve on toothpicks.
M: Butter roast turkey breast glazed with orange cranberry sauce

Roast turkey breast with a sticky cranberry and orange glaze, sage stuffing, roast potatoes and buttery green beans. Rub a 1.5kg turkey breast with 40g butter and salt and roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Simmer 150g cranberry sauce with the juice of 1 orange and 1 tbsp honey and brush over for the last 20 minutes. Mix 150g breadcrumbs, 1 fried diced onion, 2 tbsp chopped sage, 1 egg and 30g melted butter and bake in a dish for 30 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes in oil. Toss 300g green beans in butter.
W: Sponge, orange juice, strawberry jelly, custard and cream

Sponge soaked in orange juice with strawberry jelly, mixed berries, thick custard and whipped cream, topped with crushed honeycomb. Make 1 packet strawberry jelly with 500ml boiling water and cool. Break a 300g sponge cake into a glass bowl and drizzle with 100ml orange juice. Add 250g mixed berries and pour over the jelly. Chill 2 hours until set. Spoon over 600ml thick vanilla custard. Whip 300ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and spread on top. Scatter with 40g crushed honeycomb just before serving.
K: Chilled vanilla egg custard nog with cinnamon and nutmeg

Creamy homemade eggnog with vanilla, cinnamon and fresh nutmeg, cooked gently and served chilled. Alcohol-free for the whole street. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 100g caster sugar. Heat 700ml milk, 200ml cream, 1 cinnamon stick and 1 tsp vanilla until steaming. Slowly whisk into the yolks, then return to the pan and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon, about 5 minutes. Strain and chill 2 hours. Pour into 4 glasses and grate fresh nutmeg over the top.
